item.title: WATCH: Deli manager motivates kids for school
item.description: ABC News' Danny New interviews New York City bodega owner Wail Alselwi, who rewards students' good grades with cash prizes and free items.

item.title: U.S. and Iran exchange strikes for first time in a month
item.description: Iran claims it attacked U.S. bases in Jordan after CENTCOM reported strikes on rocket launchers on an Iranian island in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran live updates: US launches first strikes since July, Tehran responds with attacks
item.description: The Strait of Hormuz remains the primary flashpoint in the conflict.

item.title: House returns with vote expected on Senate bill to prevent shutdown
item.description: Lawmakers could also vote on condemning socialism and censuring GOP Rep. Chuck Edwards.
